source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hey! I wanted to send over the vision for the website.

The goal is to build a national brand website for SHATTER HOUSE that can support multiple locations and future franchise growth.

Main Website:
https://shatterhouseusa.example

For the visual direction, use a clean, modern, mobile-friendly design with simplicity similar to RageWorks USA. The branding should combine black, purple, and white with large images, generous spacing, and easy navigation.

Homepage Sections:

Hero Banner
Location Selector
Rage Rooms
Axe Throwing
Splatter Room
Corporate Events
Birthday Parties
Reviews
FAQ
Contact

The homepage should immediately show visitors what we offer and allow them to select their location.

Current Locations:

Linden Falls
Port Averly
Ridgehaven

Give every location its own dedicated page while keeping the design and branding consistent across all locations. The website should be built so future locations can be added easily without redesigning the site.

Future examples:

Mesa Crest
Highpoint
Riverbend
Franchise Locations

The overall feel should be a national entertainment brand, not a local business website.

value_updates.location_routing: Visitors select a location from the homepage to access that location's dedicated page.

Removing the legacy-site linkage does not alter the requirement that each location maintain a separate calendar.
The source contains no decision changing separate payouts or location-specific payment setups.
The candidate already records the same-message master-domain change, and removal of the legacy-site linkage requires no additional domain update.
A dedicated location page does not necessarily change the separate Wix-account model, and the source does not address account ownership or isolation.
The existing same-message Event captures the visual changes, while removal of the legacy-site linkage does not require further layout or navigation-reference changes.
The source does not change the placement or isolation of location payment processing.
The candidate already captures the source's branding decisions, and removal of the legacy-site linkage does not require another brand-identity update.
